description: Types text into a resolved editable target, optionally clearing its current value first. Without a dialog interruption, the typed and length summary confirms that the requested text was dispatched. If typing triggers a page alert, it is handled without creating an interactive dialog; typed and length are omitted because the final field value is unconfirmed, so re-read the field through the DOM. If it opens a confirm, prompt, or beforeunload dialog, the action returns its dialog id, omits typed and length, and directs the caller to Page.handleDialog before re-reading the field value.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the editable target.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the editable target.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

text.description: Text to type into the target.

clear.description: Clear existing content before typing when true.

purpose.description: Describe why this exact text is being entered, e.g., filling a search query, username, password, or form field

resolvedBy.description: Actor or resolution mode that selected the target.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

cleared.description: Whether the target value was cleared before typing.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used by the action.

dialog.description: Interactive native dialog returned while typing; handled page alerts are not returned here.

id.description: ID of an interactive native dialog returned for Page.handleDialog.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

truncated.description: Whether native dialog text was truncated.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.
